name: TEXCYCL
recent: Tex Cycle 在 2026 年 11 月 17 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩，新闻指出第三季营收同比增长 42%，但利润增长受利润率压缩拖累；首九个月净利同比增长 22% 至 RM8.9 million。公司近期也出现董事会与薪酬委员会人事变动，包括 Lee Hai Peng 与 Keh Chuan Yee 的职务调整，以及公司秘书更换。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，新闻指第三季营收同比增长 42%，首九个月净利同比增长 22% 至 RM8.9 million。
Lee Hai Peng 与 Keh Chuan Yee 出现董事会及薪酬委员会职务变动。
公司秘书由 Chan Min Wai 更换。
risks: 新闻指出第三季营收增长 42% 但利润增长受利润率压缩拖累。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 RM24.161 million，环比增长 17.3%，同比增长 179.8%；净利为 RM3.149 million，环比下降 11.4%，同比增长 4.3%；净利率为 13.0%，低于上一季度的 17.2%。

recent_en: Tex Cycle announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 17 November 2026; news reported Q3 revenue up 42% year-on-year but profit growth lagged on margin squeeze, while 9M26 net profit rose 22% to RM8.9 million. The company also saw board and remuneration committee changes involving Lee Hai Peng and Keh Chuan Yee, as well as a change of company secretary.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026; news reported Q3 revenue up 42% year-on-year and 9M26 net profit up 22% to RM8.9 million.
Board and remuneration committee changes involving Lee Hai Peng and Keh Chuan Yee.
Change of company secretary from Chan Min Wai.
risks_en: News noted Q3 revenue grew 42% but profit growth lagged on margin squeeze.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM24.161 million, up 17.3% QoQ and up 179.8% YoY; net income was RM3.149 million, down 11.4% QoQ and up 4.3% YoY; net margin was 13.0%, lower than 17.2% in the previous quarter.
